text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - warmup failures + node flaps in us-east-1-dedicated pool (model load OOMs + compile timeouts)

Priya (oncall): paging for repeated warmup failures during a canary of kernel-rollout v4.0-alpha. seeing a mix of OOMs and nvrtc compile timeouts during model load for rwd-3.0-fp16-large. Autoscaler is spinning replacements -> they hit same warmup job -> host flaps.

Luca (runtime): paste of the top error lines:
```
[2028-11-15T04:07:21Z] ERROR warmup.loader: loadShard failed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[2028-11-15T04:07:21Z] WARN compile.jit: nvrtc: JIT compilation timed out after 120s (kernel_id=kp_314)
[2028-11-15T04:07:22Z] ERROR warmup: deserialization error: checksum mismatch on shard-3
```

Marta (eng-runtime): the nvrtc timeout at 120s is our new default from the rollout. That can leave partial GPU allocations pinned until the process exits, causing OOM cascades when multiple warmups run concurrently.

Dina (eng-sre): infra metrics: 6 hosts flapped between 04:05-04:12 UTC, pod restarts spiked, and we saw 15% increase in 504s for dedicated customers in the region. AutoScale Bot shows replacement attempts hitting same readiness failures.

Priya (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout 2) disable warmup compile-on-load for large models 3) remove canary hosts from rotation 4) scale up small-fallback pool by +3. Executing now.

Deploy Bot: Rollout paused: rl-20281115-17 accepted.

Priya (oncall): applying runtime override: `PATCH /admin/pools/us-east-1-dedicated -d '{"warmup": {"compile_on_load": false, "timeout_s": 30}}'`

Luca (runtime): also set `warmup.max_concurrent_compiles=1` to avoid parallel nvrtc storms. Pushing change via configmap and restarting warmup workers gracefully.

AutoScale Bot: Scaling fallback pool us-east-1-fallback: +3 instances (requested by Priya).

Tomas (CS): one customer (cust-102) filed a support ticket about elevated latency & 504s. They wanted ETA and whether their data was affected.

Priya (oncall): Note to CS: no customer data loss or corruption seen. Some requests timed out (504). I'll draft a short status note after we stabilize.

Marta (eng-runtime): timeline: 03:50 UTC - canary rollout started (v4.0-alpha kernels) -> 04:03 UTC - first warmup compile timeout -> 04:05 UTC - cascading GPU memory reservations -> 04:07 UTC - host OOMs and restarts -> 04:15 UTC - rollout paused and runtime overrides applied.

Dina (eng-sre): rolling restart of flapped nodes without running warmup hooks now. Command used: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/warmup-worker -n redwood-runtime --grace-period=60`

Luca (runtime): dumping artifacts to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/1855016789/logs.tar.gz. Collected: warmup logs, nvrtc traces, dmesg, pod yaml.

Priya (oncall): monitoring: after overrides, warmup failures dropped to zero and no new host flaps in the last 10m. Fallback pool handling approx 22% of traffic for affected model.

Tomas (CS): I'll notify cust-102 and cust-213 with current status: incident mitigated, no data loss, engineering investigating root cause.

Marta (eng-runtime): short term followups proposed: - reduce default nvrtc timeout for canaries - add OOM-safe warmup mode that skips compile and uses interpreter path - add memory pre-check to skip warmup if free_gpu_mem < X. Owners: Luca/Marta.

Dina (eng-sre): infrastructure followups: - add readiness gating to autoscaler to avoid immediate replacements during warmup storms - increase granularity of GPU mem metrics to 1s -> owner Dina.

Priya (oncall): handing off to Luca for next 2h. Current status: mitigated -> contained. Leaving notes: keep rollout paused, don't re-enable compile_on_load for large models until postmortem.

Incident Bot: Incident INC-20281115-02 marked mitigated; awaiting postmortem.

Luca (runtime): leaving additional artifacts: `/var/artifacts/incidents/1855016789/` and `s3://redwood-incidents/1855016789/`. Commands used for log collection: `kubectl logs -l app=warmup-worker -n redwood-runtime --since=3h > warmup-all.log`

Dina (eng-sre): root cause hypothesis for postmortem: new kernel variant increases JIT compile time and memory residency; combined with parallel canary warmups causes pinned allocations and eventual OOM. Will validate against NVRTC traces.

Priya (oncall): postmortem action items (owners): - runtime: implement warmup safe-fallback & compile concurrency cap (Luca) - release: improve rollout canary to run warmup smoke test on micro instance first (Dina) - platform: add autoscaler warmup gating (Dina) - CS: customer comms template (Tomas)

Tomas (CS): I'll send an interim customer email and include the timeline + expected next steps.

Priya (oncall): handing over to Luca at 04:18 UTC. Ping me if regressions reappear. :thumbsup:
